description: Issues an access token for scan_business_card, good for 3 free reads. Call it once, before the first scan. It needs the name of the assistant or app calling, and your user's name and email address; ask your user first and set user_consent to true only if they agreed to share them with Krane. One access per email address: asking again returns the same token and what is left on it.

agent.description: The assistant or app making this call, e.g. "ChatGPT" or your product's name.

purpose.description: Optional: what the cards are for, in a few words.

user_consent.description: true only if your user agreed to share their name and email with Krane.

name: request_scan_access
title: Get access to read business cards
